'''Sean McGrath''' is a ''Star Wars'' CCG player. He played the Light Side in a Vintage Stock Tour sealed deck tournament run by [[Vicki Luthy]] in Kansas City on 2 August 2003.<ref name="pcf-1855-32057" />
